artworks.title: Portrait of a Domestic Servant
artworks.dimensions:
image (visible): 9 x 7 cm (3 9/16 x 2 3/4 in.)
framed: 15.1 x 12.7 cm (5 15/16 x 5 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman's upper body while she is seated. She is positioned facing slightly towards her left, gazing directly at the camera. Her facial features are defined by a serious expression, with visible wrinkles, and she wears a white cap that covers all her hair. The woman is dressed in a dark shawl draped over her shoulders and a lighter-colored skirt. In her right hand, she holds a small book, and her left hand rests on a table adorned with a fringed cloth. The background is a plain curtain with some texture. The photograph is framed in a decorated casing with a black border and gold edging.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a woman, capturing her upper body and face. She is positioned slightly turned to her right but looks directly forward. The woman has prominent facial features with a soft expression, and her light brown hair is styled in voluminous curls that frame her face. Her clothing is not clearly visible. The portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with intricate gold patterns on a warm background. The background appears dark, highlighting the subject's features, all housed within a decorative outer frame.

artworks.title: Two Women and Three Children in Garden
artworks.description: The image features an oval-shaped photograph encased in a black and gold frame. In the photo, a group of people is in an outdoor setting. In the center, a woman stands next to a child. In front of them is a wooden pushcart with a baby seated inside. Two other people are partially visible to the side. The background is blurred, suggesting a natural setting with trees or foliage. The color scheme is sepia-toned, indicating an aged photograph.

artworks.title: H.M.S. Dauntless at Anchor in Carlisle Bay, Barbados
artworks.description: The image shows a view of the sea with ships on it. The horizon line is slightly above the middle, where the sea meets the sky. There is a silhouetted ship with tall masts on the horizon, and another smaller vessel is visible further to the right. The color palette is sepia-toned, with muted browns and grays. The style is more photographic, with realistic details and crisp outlines of the ships' rigging. The image conveys a sense of calmness and timelessness.

artworks.title: Rievaulx Abbey, the North Transept
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a building, displaying both its side and front architectural features. The landscape extends into the distance with rolling hills in the background. The color palette is sepia tones. The structure appears to be a ruin with Gothic arches and weathered stonework. Vegetation grows on parts of the building. A dirt path curves away from the ruins with a forest in the distance.

artworks.title: Mrs. Keene
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up portrait of a person's face and upper torso. The individual is facing forward, with facial features such as eyes, nose, and lips. The person has long, wavy hair, a headdress made of leaves and flowers, and is wearing a dark garment with a decorative pattern at the neckline. The background is blurred.

artworks.title: Mary Fisher
artworks.description: The image shows the upper portion of a woman's body, focusing on her face and upper torso. She is in a seated position, facing forward with a slightly upward tilt of the head. Her facial features include a long face with prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and full lips, framed by straight, shoulder-length hair parted in the middle. She wears a dark garment layered over a patterned blouse and around her neck is a choker-style necklace with a round pendant. The background is blurred and indistinct, creating a soft, faded look around her, enhancing the focus on her face. The entire image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: An Angel unwinged by your desire
artworks.description: This is a sepia toned photograph showing a young girl sitting on the ground, facing the right, with her back against a dark wall or structure. Her legs are bent, and her right arm is holding her knee. She has pale skin and long, wavy, blonde or light brown hair. Her eyes are almost closed, and her mouth is slightly open. She wears no clothes or shoes. The background is dark brown, with some hazy, indistinct white shapes in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Summer Days
artworks.description: The image features four people captured from the chest up. Two young children are seated closely together in the foreground. Behind them, a woman with dark hair and a broad-brimmed hat adorned with leaves is seated. Also behind the children stands another woman with short hair styled under a straw hat. The background shows a textured wall with diagonal lines on one half.

artworks.title: Adolphus Liddell, Junior
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a partial view of their upper body. The person's head is slightly turned to the side, with their gaze directed slightly downward and to the right of the frame. They have light-colored skin, a softer jawline with visible facial hair concentrated along the jaw and sideburns, and a solemn expression. Their hair is short and dark, mostly covered by a dark hat adorned with a white feather. They are dressed in dark clothing, likely a cloak or robe, as no visible shirt collar or detail is evident. There is no visible jewelry or objects held in their hand. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: William Holman Hunt
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated with a slight lean to his right. His facial features include a full beard and mustache, and his gaze is directed slightly away from the camera. His hair is covered by a turban wrapped around his head, with a few strands visible. He is wearing a striped tunic. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by him. The background is neutral, a plain backdrop. The image has an oval vignette, and it appears to be in black and white.

artworks.title: Joseph D. Hooker
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body from the chest upwards in profile, slightly turned to the left. He has a prominent forehead with receding hair, long wavy strands, dense sideburns, and a long beard. He is dressed in formal attire with a buttoned waistcoat under a dark jacket. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Elizabeth Keown, Kate Keown, and Freddy Gould
artworks.description: Three children with different hairstyles and clothing styles are depicted against a natural background. The left child has long, wavy hair and a contemplative expression. The center child wears a wide-brimmed hat and a dress with puffed sleeves, with a distant gaze. The right child, with a flat top hat and a sailor-style shirt, is holding a basket and a stick. Foliage fills the background, suggesting an outdoors setting.

artworks.title: Old Tree near Chatham
artworks.description: The image features a large, gnarled tree on the left side of the composition. The horizon is obscured by the sloping ground and a picket fence. Near the tree, there is a wooden structure with a chain, possibly a feeding trough, and a barrel. Other leafless trees and a clear sky are visible in the background. The color palette is predominantly sepia, creating an antique look with brown and cream tones.

artworks.title: Lock-Keeper's Cottage and Lock Gates
artworks.description: The image shows a canal scene from an elevated vantage point, featuring a lock on the waterway. The canal reflects surrounding structures and a tree. On the left is a white house with windows facing the water, surrounded by foliage and a large tree. The lock is at the center with railings, and figures are present. In the distance, a gravel pathway runs parallel to the canal, leading to more trees and vegetation. The horizon is visible high in the frame with a cloudy sky above.

artworks.title: Church from a River Bank
artworks.description: The image shows a church with a tall, pointed spire at the center. Leafless trees partially obscure the view, and a body of water is nearby with a man poling a small boat.

artworks.title: View of Fields with Cows
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wide, open sky dominating the frame. The perspective is slightly elevated, looking out over a rural countryside. At the lower third of the image, there are rolling hills with patches of trees. In the foreground, there is a field with several dark figures that appear to be cattle. The sepia color palette gives the scene a vintage and warm atmosphere. The image appears to be a photograph, without discernible brushstrokes, relying on the natural textures of the landscape.

artworks.title: Woman, Surrey County Asylum
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, seated with her hands clasped. She is facing the camera straight on. She has a somber expression with slightly downturned lips and a gaze directed at the viewer. Her hair is parted in the middle and falls in long, loose waves down past her shoulders. She is wearing a long-sleeved, plaid-patterned dress with a high neckline, and her clothing fits modestly. Her hands are resting in her lap, and she is not holding any objects. The background is plain with a textured curtain providing a backdrop.

artworks.title: A Shrimp Fisher Girl
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her body slightly turned to the side. She holds a large basket in one hand and leans on a fish net with the other. She has a subtle smile and her gaze is directed to the side. She wears a headscarf, a striped, long-sleeved top, a knee-length skirt, and is barefoot. Shells are scattered around her on the ground. The background features a textured wall and a tree trunk to the right.

artworks.title: Ariadne
artworks.dimensions:
image (rounded top): 20.4 x 15.5 cm (8 1/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
mount: 40.7 x 33.2 cm (16 x 13 1/16 in.)

artworks.title: Lionel Tennyson
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a young person seated with their right arm resting on a surface and their hand supporting their chin. The person is positioned in a relaxed manner, gazing to their left. They have wavy, shoulder-length light-colored hair, a smooth complexion, and a contemplative expression. The person is wearing a slightly oversized coat with visible buttons on the cuff and lapel. The background is out of focus and dark. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or other objects being held.

artworks.title: She Never Told Her Love
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph depicts a young woman sitting in a slightly reclined position, facing the left, with her head and torso propped up on pillows against the back of a chair. She has pale skin and long, dark, curly hair flowing down her shoulders. Her eyes are closed, and her mouth appears partially open. She wears a long, light-colored garment and sits with her hands in her lap. Her legs seem to be covered by a long cloth or a blanket, but her knees seem to be bent. The background features a dark textured curtain or wall, with some indistinct objects in the lower right corner. The lighting is soft, illuminating the woman while the rest of the room is in shadow.

artworks.title: Harbor in Dordrecht
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray brown wash with scraping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image displays a river scene with a view across the water towards the opposite bank. The horizon shows trees and a building with a tower. The artwork has a style with small, delicate, and repetitive cross-hatched lines. The color palette is mainly sepia and dark brown. In the foreground, boats are docked along the river, reflecting in the water. Further away, more trees and buildings are hinted at through light and shadow.
